name: Zerubbabel
overview: Zerubbabel, also known as Sheshbazzar and called Zorobabel in genealogies, was a key leader who directed the return of the Jewish exiles from Babylon and oversaw the rebuilding of the altar and temple in Jerusalem. Scripture highlights his role in organizing the people to offer burnt offerings according to the law of Moses and appointing the Levites to inaugurate the temple's restoration. His leadership was instrumental in reestablishing proper worship and the physical presence of God’s house among the emancipated Jews.
